messages:
arun: Heads-up: launching two billing changes next week — (1) prepaid credit pools and (2) 7-day overage smoothing for bursty routes. Posting rollout and ops notes here.

claire: Summary for folks skimming: prepaid pools let customers load USD into an org-level bucket and debit per-request. Overage smoothing spreads big spikes across 7 days on invoices so customers see a less jarring line-item.

arun: Why we built it: customers repeatedly asked for predictable short-term economics without committing to Dedicated. Prepaid pools reduce invoice surprises and give a cheaper path than pure pay-as-you-go for steady but variable traffic.

finance-bot: Billing mechanics: prepaid charge occurs at pool creation. Pool balance is used before metered billing. If a pool empties, requests bill normally or follow a configured fallback.

claire: Quick example CLI to create a pool: 
```
# create a $2000 pool in eu-central
redwood billing pools create --name "edge-staging" --amount 2000 --currency USD --region eu-central-1
```

eng-release: API additions (internal): POST /v1/billing/pools, GET /v1/billing/pools/{pool_id}/balance, POST /v1/billing/pools/{pool_id}/topup, PATCH /v1/billing/pools/{pool_id}/attach-route. Auth: org-billing scope required.

support-bot: CS checklist: one-pager, canned replies, troubleshooting steps for: failed top-ups, pool not applying to route, partial top-ups. Draft at <https://redwood.internal/cs/prepay-pools|CS prepay draft>.

zoe: Sizing guidance from FinOps: for traffic with daily spikes we recommend 1.5x expected weekly spend. For unpredictable burst patterns, 3x to avoid frequent fallbacks. We'll add a calculator in Console.

arun: Invoice presentation: line items will include route label + pool id when used. Legal requested explicit mapping so customers can reconcile. Engineering: add "route_name" to invoice lines.

finance-bot: Refund policy: customers can request refund of remaining prepaid balance. Refunds processed within 30 days. A small processing fee applies: 2% for refunds under $150, waived above $150. Money movement rules documented in internal billing playbook.

claire: Free credits interaction: trial/free credits remain separate and will not be consumed by prepaid pools. Prepaid pools only apply after free credits are used or if route bypasses free credit logic. We'll state this clearly in FAQ.

eng-release: Rollout plan: billing-service v3.9.2 scheduled: canary Friday 02:00 UTC -> region rollouts over 6 hours -> global. Feature flag gated: "billing.prepayPools.v1". Console UI behind same flag.

support-bot: Support staffing: recommend standby for 48 hours post-GA. Triage playbook linked. Escalation to finance on failed chargebacks.

zoe: Rate limits note: pools do NOT change rate limits. Quotas and throttles still enforced per-route. Pools only affect how usage is billed.

claire: Accounting note: revenue recognition for prepaid amounts follows our deferred revenue policy. Finance will amortize as usage occurs; see revenue runbook for details.

arun: Monitoring & alerts: new Console widgets: pool balance, 24h burn-rate, 7-day smoothing delta. Add alert if burn-rate > 2x historical mean for 15m.

eng-release: Ops checklist pushed to #eng-oncall: canaries, smoke tests for invoice labels, migration script to reconcile pending topups.

claire: Public comms: blog + docs + Console banner scheduled Tuesday 16:00 PT. CS email templates will go out same day. Marketplace/reseller support not included in v1.

arun: Any objections?

finance-bot: none recorded.

support-bot: CS ready with one-pager.

zoe: no objections from FinOps.

arun: Awesome. If anyone has follow-ups, add comments to the launch doc or DM me. :thumbsup:
